notes.title: Steam Visual Novel Fest: The Star Legation
notes.content:
[b][h2]The Star Legation for only $8.99[/h2][/b]

Build relationships with each of your alien crew on an adventure in space in this cinematic, choice-driven visual novel with RPG elements. Customize the skills of the protagonist, Trey Donovan, and make over 500 choices in this branching-path story with multiple, voice-acted endings that depend on the relationships you've built during your journey. Negotiate with powerful alien leaders to gain their trust, make crucial decisions as a starship commander, engage in choice-driven battles (optional), and pursue romance with one of the 2 female human contacts. 

But be careful, because many of your decisions influence your reputation with each crew member, the alien leaders, and your romantic interests. 5 main endings with 3 variations each depend on your choices and your reputation. Can you unite all the alien races in an interstellar alliance? Will you win someone's heart along the way? Or will you meet with disaster by endangering your crew, yourself, or even doom an entire species? Use your chosen skills to find a path to success in this engaging and meaningful visual novel!

[b]*8 to over 12 hours of adventure with bizarre alien companions
*RPG-style character design skill choices for your main character
*Visit exotic locations on alien worlds
*Meet powerful alien leaders and negotiate with them to gain their trust
*Battles (optional) in space and in person
*Over 500 choices that affect your relationships and how the story branches
*Develop a romance across the stars! Two different human women might be interested...
*40 different original music compositions (99 minutes!)
*15+ High res CG's to unlock
*5 different possible endings, each voice acted by one of 3 voice actors 
*Enjoy drama, comedy, action, mystery, and romance in this epic Space Opera![/b]

notes.title: The Star Legation space adventure, 40% Off Sale!
notes.content:
[b]For $8.99, you can journey through space with an alien crew![/b]

Play as the unlikely representative of the human race, Trey Donovan, and customize his skills for a journey through space with an alien crew. Your mission: visit strange new worlds and convince powerful alien leaders to join the Interstellar Union. Can you brave the dangers of space, survive deadly battles, navigate delicate diplomatic encounters, and manage your own bizarre alien crew? Build relationships with memorable characters and develop reputations with each that will alter the course of the story, including a possible romance across the stars! 

What you're getting in The Star Legation, a choice-driven cinematic visual novel with RPG elements:

*8 to over 12 hours of adventure with bizarre alien companions

notes.title: Help Nominate The Star Legation!
notes.content:
Thanks for considering the story of The Star Legation for nomination in Steam's "Outstanding Story-Rich Game" in the 2022 Steam Awards.

The story of The Star Legation is packed with drama and adventure, largely focused on the importance of building meaningful relationships while seeking unity despite cultural differences. Explore a variety of viewpoints and experience many challenges with your alien crew as you journey through space to build a peaceful alliance. Develop possible romantic relationships with your human contacts and address deep questions about life and free will as you choose from over 500 choices that shape your story. This narrative is delivered through a light-hearted and comedic lense with expressive and emotive character art and music. I hope you enjoyed the story and characters as much as I enjoyed writing this visual novel! If it was a memorable experience for you, please consider this nomination. Thanks for your support! 
-Andy

notes.title: The Star Legation OST update!
notes.content:
Imagine my horror when a purchaser of The Star Legation OST notified me today that, though he was able to download the zip file from Steam, the music files were not in the file! I immediately tried to figure out what went wrong...

Though I had properly uploaded the zip file to the site, AND Steam had reviewed and approved it (even after telling me I had a redundancy in the file, which I corrected and re-uploaded...waiting 3 more days for another approval), it seems that the file did not get seated properly in the correct depot. I have fixed this issue and the purchaser was able to download it again and found all the files inside the zip file as he should have.

I'm so sorry that this has happened and I apologize to those of you that purchased the OST and wondered what happened to the music. It's ready and waiting for you to download again!

I hope you enjoy my music, and thanks for your support (and patience!)
Best,
Andy

notes.title: My journey as a new, solo-developer...
notes.content:
I just wanted to say thanks to everyone who has shown interest and support over the past 3 years of development, it's meant a lot to me to know you're out there and are excited about the game! This has been a long journey for me, and I can definitely say that I've put my best into The Star Legation. 

Just a little background information, if you're interested: This is my first time programming a game, which is why I used the Tyranobuilder visual novel engine to make it. Tyranobuilder has an excellent modular system that allows for tools to be assembled without the need to write much code. Of course, over time, I did learn to write some code, and I added in a lot of cinematic animations and cutscenes to embellish the storytelling. 

Who am I? I'm a professional musician, a writer, and a tabletop role-playing game writer and designer of Solar Echoes. 3 years ago, I decided to try making my first video game...

I spent my first year writing the huge story for The Star Legation, which ended up being almost 1000 pages long--the length of 3 large novels! Of course, playing the game won't feel as long because there are multiple routes and experiences you won't have with only 1 playthrough of the game. During the time I was working on the story, I also was playing around with Tyranobuilder so I knew what I was going to be using. It helped me write the story script in a style that was easy to cut and paste into the game.

I also commissioned a lot of artwork during that first year, and I'm glad I did it then, because art takes a lot of time and direction. I had the pleasure of working with 4 very talented artists at different times--each was specialized in what they did:
[b]John Fell[/b]: character artist
[b]Lee Madison[/b]: starship and space artist
[b]Alexis Rill[/b]: starship interior background artist
[b]Aeghite[/b]: CG's, outdoor and some indoor background artist (plus the Omul character and Kaori's casual outfit)

The next two years were spent programming, customizing artwork assets, and composing. I wrote a lot of the music alongside the scenes that I was doing, and I often played parts of the scene while humming to come up with my musical ideas. You can find more details, if you're interested, in my composer notes that are included with the 99 minute, 40 track OST.

I did encounter some very difficult times during development, however. The game engine, Tyranobulder (TB), stopped exporting my game to a playable application because the game had grown too large. Thankfully, in August of 2021, TB was updated to version 2.0, and this fixed that issue, along with many others. However, as with most updates, some things became problems. Camera movement became inconsistent in some areas that I had to rework, and character sprite facings (left and right) were reversed in the code, so I needed to go through the entire game and invert the code so people were facing the correct way when talking. There were also odd animation issues to rework and work around.

And, the biggest issue that I still haven't been able to resolve: TB 2.0 currently does not export to Mac anymore. This is why a demo for Mac existed, but I currently don't have a Mac version for sale. I'm still trying out some workarounds on this issue, but until I'm confident the Mac version runs properly through the entire game (which I can't test because I don't own a Mac), I won't release a Mac version. 

Despite those few issues with TB, though, I never would have been able to build this game without it. I'm very thankful to have found a development program that fit my limited experience in programming, and I've learned a lot since I started using it. 

So anyway, that's my journey as a first-time game developer. I really hope you all enjoy the story and find it meaningful, thought-provoking, and fun. I also hope you really love the characters--I had a great time writing them and I honestly miss them now. Thanks again, so much, for your interest and support! Feel free to share your experiences and thoughts about the game here. Hearing your reactions and opinions is very rewarding to me. 

Have fun!
Best,
Andy

notes.title: The Star Legation game and OST have released!
notes.content:
[h2]After 3 years in solo-development, The Star Legation has finally launched! [/h2]

Customize the skills of the protagonist, Trey Donovan, and journey through space with a bizarre alien crew. Visit strange new worlds, negotiate with powerful alien leaders, and survive the deadly challenges of space, battle, and even your own crew! Risk romance across the stars and navigate every relationship with decisions that progressively affect your reputation with each character. Your choices really matter as your fate and the fate of your crew depend upon the reputations you've built and the difficult decisions you'll make. Are you ready for a meaningful and unforgettable space adventure?

[h2]Enjoy the music of The Star Legation with the 40-track, 99 minute OST![/h2]

The Original Soundtrack for The Star Legation includes musical pieces by professional musician and composer, Andy Mitchell. Described as a combination of techno and classical, each track was specifically designed to convey the mood and theme of a scene, with a wide variety of musical techniques and cultural elements used to reflect each alien cultural. The OST includes 40 tracks and 99 minutes of music, in addition to 9 pages of detailed composer notes about each title.

notes.title: Windows Release confirmed for Feb. 4. Mac version pending...
notes.content:
[h1]The Good News:[/h1]

[b]The Windows build of The Star Legation has been reviewed and approved by Steam, and will launch on schedule for 2/4/22.[/b]

[h1]The Bad News:[/h1]

[b]I have decided to remove the option for the Mac build temporarily from the store[/b], because I am uncertain whether a working build will be ready in time. Here is an update on the Mac version, and why there are delays for it:

1. As mentioned before, the game engine I used to build The Star Legation was updated and it currently does not support export to Macs as it used to (in the earlier version, I was able to create a demo for the Mac without problems.) However, I cannot roll back to the earlier version of the game engine because that version no longer exports games the size of The Star Legation, and it would also require a degree of re-coding many elements of the game.

2. I have several people experimenting with a work-around to the export problem, using a Japanese version of the program. Using this method, an export was successful, but it behaved differently than expected and some re-coding was done to make the beginning of the game play out properly. I am currently unsure of how the rest of the game runs, and cannot test it myself because a Mac is necessary. One of my beta testers is attempting to run this new version on his Mac, but the process of ensuring quality across the entire build is slow. 

Unless I can confirm that the Mac export functions properly without bugs, the Mac version will be delayed indefinitely. If such confirmation can be reached, however, I will add a Mac version to the store as soon as possible and will announce its availability here. Keep in mind, I am a first-time programmer and am still learning. Most of this is over my head. I apologize for the confusion and the wait.

Best,
Andy
Corefun Studios, LLC

notes.title: The Star Legation release delayed to February 4th, 2022
notes.content:
[b]With great regret, I must delay the release of The Star Legation until February 4th. [/b]

I am sincerely frustrated and upset that I have had to make this decision, because the game is finished...for Windows. I ran into a problem with my game engine this week when I tried to compile a beta copy for a Mac beta-tester. Though export for Mac worked for me in a previous version of the game engine, a recent update to the engine now requires a Mac and it can also only be exported successfully using the Japanese version of the engine.

I want to make sure that the Mac users interested in The Star Legation are not left out. The extra time allows me to get the help I need to attempt to work out a solution using the Japanese version of the game engine, despite the language barrier complicating things. 

[i]If the problem can't be solved before February, I will release the game on February 4th for Windows users only.[/i]

However, while I get the help I need to solve this issue, this extra time also allows me to add some extra features that my beta testers have suggested. I will also be able to add more polish and possibly a few more animations to the game. I have had great response from my beta testers to the beta and I am very, very excited to share this memorable space adventure with you!

Thank you so much for your patience. I will make it worth the wait!
Best,
Andy

notes.title: Star Legation Release Date Soon and Special News!
notes.content:
The [b]targeted release date of December 21st[/b] is just a few weeks away, and things are looking very promising! I am more than 97% finished with the game and am hoping to send out beta copies next week. Of course, there is the possibility of a slight delay because I want to make sure this is as polished as I know how to make it with my limited programming skills, but December 21st is likely!

I also wanted to let you know about some exciting news--I am adding in a fun surprise at the end of the game with the [b]epilogues voice acted[/b] by 3 different voice actors. The voice actor you'll hear depends on the ending you get, which will be based on your relationship choices throughout the game. I'm so excited to be working with Katie Otten, Sayaka Mashiro, and Josh Portillo for these final epilogue scenes!

Please stay tuned, and I apologize for the "radio silence." I'm spending every spare moment working on the game so that I can have this epic space adventure ready for you to enjoy over the holidays!

Best,
Andy
Corefun Studios, LLC

notes.title: Release Date Postponed to Q4
notes.content:
I apologize for the release delay, but even though I have been able to put in 5 to 7 hours a day into development (in addition to my regular job), I realize it is unrealistic for me to be able to complete the game by this summer. I appreciate your patience and support, and want to assure you that daily progress is being made. As a solo developer, it is challenging to juggle all the programming, editing, music composing, animation, sound effects, etc. and move things as quickly as I would like. 

The Star Legation is nearly 50% complete and there are processes and systems in place now that will hopefully make development time more efficient. Thank you so much for your interest in The Star Legation, and rest assured, I will finish it and am working hard to make this the best game for you that I possibly can, despite being a first-time programmer.

-Andy
